notes.title: Update 10
notes.content:
Version 1.1.3
- Corrected the translation of the intro screen.
- Reduced skipping of the game intro screen.
- Fixed bug where if the player passed the challenge mode stages, it interfered with the adventure mode level selector.
- Removed using the Dash with the right shoulder button. 

This is a small update, making some adjustments and correcting minor errors that existed in the game.
Thanks to everyone for their support.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update 9
notes.content:
Version 1.1.2

- Centralization of the fade circle on the character when starting the level.
- New moon art on levels 21 to 40.
- Improved mountain art for levels 41 to 60 and the challenge.
- Corrected the trampoline's repeated animation and sound when you die by colliding with it.
- Fixed premature collision of the single electric sphere into orbs.
- Fixed the bug of playing two songs simultaneously.
- Reduced song information display time from 1 second to 0.3 seconds, making it more dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413067/f255291920c3e4df5e14220179bcfd06f97ff4ba.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
Version 1.1.1

- Added music when Squab meets his father.
- Changed the crystal artwork.
- Changed the cage artwork.
- Reduced the fade time after death, making the game more dynamic.

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.0[/b]

- Added Steam Cloud save support.
- Added intro and ending cutscene.

Jumping thorn trap
- Changed the artwork, added animations always looking in the player's direction when on the ground.
- Improved the detection of the player's jump, correcting a small bug that occurred when the player jumped quickly and when the player fell. 
- Added sound when the jumping thorn touches the inverter box.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413067/0b66ad4881be71d400767127afc60452bf1cf258.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413067/c496db6845905001449f314ec423e52ef6a6f707.png[/img][/url]

- Improved the physics of the ball, now all collisions make it bounce, this way the player has more control and prediction of the ball's trajectory.
- Removed the ball freezing bug if you use dash and touch the ball.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413067/cadd1a72ffffe001d2d60775322fe1d632fef6cd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413067/cadd1a72ffffe001d2d60775322fe1d632fef6cd.gif[/img][/url]

- Added 3 variations of the song to the final screen of the game.
- Added Squab's father to the final screen.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.6[/b]

It's with great pleasure that I'm announcing the Japanese translation for the game, something that was totally unplanned, but with the help of Hiroshi Ashida, who got in touch by email, it was possible to do the translation, checking the texts, the quality of the characters, because in the game we don't use a font, but a Sprite Font, where you have to draw all the characters. Finally, I'm very proud of the end result, as you can see in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413067/41a261516673a27e0f543227489dc6af13e098fd.jpg[/img]

- Added the Japanese language to the game, with the help of [b]Hiroshi Ashida[/b].
- Added sound when returning from the menus.
- On level 17, added 2 thorns on the block behind the player, forcing him to use the bubble, changed the design of where the player starts, forcing the player to collide with the bubble from below, this way better indicating the range of the impulse when popping the bubble, which is enough to reach the top.
- At level 42, changed the starting position of the electric current on the left side of the screen, giving the player a little more time to jump.

- Changed level 5 of the challenge, placing the crystal a little higher.

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Version 1.0.5

- Fixed the error in the spinning orb trap, where some electric spheres remained without collision, only the first one which should not contain colliders to make it easier for the player to step on the square block and not be so punitive.
- Removed 1 spinning blade from level 49, slightly changing the difficulty.

- Fixed the bug where the options chosen such as vibrate, shake and full screen were not marked on the options screen.
- Fixed bug where after choosing an option or leaving a menu screen, it was still possible to execute commands, affecting several menu screens.
- Fixed a bug where, when returning to the menu and quickly pressing Esc on the keyboard or B on the controller, the cursor was in the wrong place.
- It is only possible to pause the game, if Squab is alive, after the fade when entering the level and before opening the door.

- The hat you choose is now stored once you've chosen it, so you don't have to choose it again every time you play.
- In the stage selection, the last stage is also stored, so you don't have to go through all the stages to choose the last one, for example.

- On the final screen of the game, the player's record has been added if they have played the Speedrun mode.

The current update is focused on improving the overall quality of the game, correcting small bugs in the menus, as well as adjusting traps. We are committed to making the game better and better, so if you have any suggestions for improvement or find any bugs, please let us know.

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Version 1.0.4

- Fixed the bug where the hat was not released when you finished challenge mode before finishing adventure mode.
- Fixed the bug where the trampoline would fall on the character, locking it, now the trampoline crushes the character.
- Adjusted the spring collider to the size of the sprite, improving the mechanics.
- Fixed the bug whereby after entering challenge mode, returning to the menu and entering level 2 onwards, the option to return to the stage selection screen did not appear.
- Reduced the fire collider when it's small.

- Reworked the song name sign, now an icon is shown and the text is positioned more to the left of the screen.

If you find any bugs in the game, let us know and we'll fix them as soon as possible.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
Version 1.0.3

- It was discovered that at times using the dash and with the frame rate at 60fps, the character was able to climb on some platforms where he shouldn't, which completely eliminated the challenge of some levels, as it is not a feature that requires skill, I decided to make some changes to the mechanics and also added some thorns in some levels that it was possible to skip the whole challenge, in addition to slight changes
- Modified normal levels 8, 12, 15, 18, 34, 38, 44, 45, 52, 58
- Modified challenge levels 3,4.

- Adjusted the dash animation, when the character touches a wall or block, the animation takes a little longer to finish, giving better feedback.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2

- Fixed the keyboard input in the level 1 tutorial, the correct keyboard key is W not H.
- Fixed the error where the character could die at the level 40 checkpoint.
